purpose: Close Ironman / Equilibrium training-data gaps for post–20 Jul 2026 Fletching (mid-game rebalance), Ranged chinchompa utility, and high-level Slayer master region gates — including region combo friction. Do not trust pre-rebalance Fletching level gates or ironman Fletching ladders as current truth.

methods.summary: 20 Jul 2026 mid-game rebalance re-tiered core bows, crossbows, arrows and bolts to align Fletching with modern Ranged / Woodcutting / Smithing ladders. Darts, knives and javelins were intentionally left for later work.
planner_rules: Do not copy pre-20-Jul Fletching level requirements for core bows, crossbows, arrows or bolts without rechecking the rebalance tables.
Wiki Pay-to-play Fletching training page is marked out of date for the rebalance — use method families and infrastructure here, not its stale level-band tables as absolute truth.
High-end reference rates already captured in midgame-rebalance-2026-07-20.json: primal arrows ~900k XP/h, primal bolts ~975k XP/h.

rebalance_highlights.longbows: Shieldbows reverted to longbows; +1 attack range (up to 9) vs shortbows/crossbows (range 7). Longbows match shortbow combat stats except range; longbows need +5 Fletching vs same-tier shortbow.
rebalance_highlights.crossbows: Crossbow Fletching sits ~+3 levels over same-tier shortbows; stock wood now matches Woodcutting tier (e.g. mithril xbow uses teak stock, not maple).
new_mid_tiers: Eternal magic longbow + primal 2h crossbow (99 band)
rebalance_highlights.primal_ammo_process: Primal bolts (unf) are 50 per bar then feathered (no more primal bolt tips + eternal magic headless shafts). Primal arrows still use eternal magic shafts. Proficiency levelling benefits removed; XP increased.
rebalance_highlights.bane_ammo: Tune Bane Ore now tunes finished bane arrows/bolts into abyssal/basilisk/dragon/wallasalkibane ammo (Jas-dragonbane style). Ironman smithing gate effectively higher (80 vs old 76 path).
rebalance_highlights.f2p_impact: Yew/magic bows now require 70/80 Ranged — no longer free-to-play weapons.

methods.summary: Post-rebalance mid-game path should follow re-tiered shortbow → longbow (+5 Fletching) → matching ammo, then orikalkum/necronium/bane/elder ammo and stocks as levels open — not the pre-rebalance maple/yew/magic level gates.
path_notes: Early: shafts / headless shafts / low-tier bows remain the on-ramp; exact XP tables on the wiki guide are pre-rebalance and must be revalidated.
Mid: maple re-tiered toward 40 Ranged band; acadia fills the tier-50 bow gap; yew/magic sit at 70/80 Ranged with matching Fletching.
Crossbow chain now tracks metal tiers with correct stock woods (teak→…→eternal) — ironman material planning is Smithing + Woodcutting dual-gated.
Ammo: arrow/bolt Fletching levels re-aligned; smithing XP on heads/unf bolts was cut hard (−27.5% iron up to −50% primal) so ironman head production is slower relative to Fletching XP.
High: eternal magic bows / primal crossbows and primal ammo are the known end-band; use 900k/975k only as ceiling references, not guaranteed ironman rates without self-sourced materials.

Darts still appear on the stale wiki guide as 'fastest' mid/high methods — rebalance explicitly did not retier darts/knives/javelins; treat dart XP as possibly still valid but separate from the re-tiered core ladder.

methods.name: Ranger's Workroom (Fort Forinthry)
methods.region_note: Physical building is Fort Forinthry. Catalyst League historically filed Fort under Misthalin; user/planner may treat Fort+Raptor as Forinthry-adjacent wilderness framing. Keep dual-label until Equilibrium publishes a hard Fort boundary.
requirements: Dead and Buried (partial for T1 build progress; full for higher tiers)

tier_1: 2% chance to save resources while fletching various weapons and ammo (arrows, bolts, darts; also unstrung bows/stocks, feathering, proteans, bamboo bundles per wiki testing notes)
Bank chest, spinning wheel, fletching workbench, ranged target
tier_2: 1% chance extra ranged ammo / headless shafts (full XP on extras)
2% chance to produce strung bows when fletching unstrung bows (string XP equivalent)
tier_3: +5% base Fletching XP inside the workroom (stacks multiplicatively with other XP boosts)
Wisdom of Anima toggle on the workbench (dinarrows imbued efficiently but low XP)

usage_notes: Bonuses apply while standing in the workroom — workbench click not required. Bank chest + portable fletcher inside room is the common setup; W84 GE portables also common.
Brooch of the Gods extends portable fletcher save rates (wiki table: 10% → 20% with brooch on relevant saves).
Still valid and high-value post-rebalance: infrastructure bonuses are independent of item re-tiering.

materials.note: Core bow stocks after rebalance expect wood tier = weapon tier. Self-source wherever trees exist in unlocked regions.
New tier-50 bow band; Menaphos/desert acadia is the natural self-source.
Primal arrows and late eternal magic bow work still consume eternal magic shaft pipeline.
Smithing XP on heads/unf bolts cut in rebalance; plan more bars per Fletching XP hour.
Bane ammo now tuned from finished bane arrows/bolts via Tune Bane — no longer the old banite-ore-from-remains smithing maze. Still needs bane metal production.
Flax/spinning is global-ish; fungal bowstring from Accidental F&F shafts is Anachronia-gated stackable alternative. Ranger's Workroom spinning wheel colocates with fletch bank.
GE remains default portable hub; ironmen rely more on Fort workroom self-infrastructure.

methods.summary: Chinchompas are stackable thrown Ranged weapons with innate 3×3 AoE (up to 9 targets) dealing 90–110% of the ability damage applied to the primary target per thrown chin (Combat Style Modernisation 2 Mar 2026).
combat_utility: Primary mid-game multi-target Ranged tool for stacked tasks, abyss-style piles, and general AoE training.
Each throw consumes one chinchompa; ability-based explosion (not old ability-duplication model).
Mechanised chinchompas (Invention) are a higher-tier red-chin product path, not a separate hunt region.

methods.summary: High-level Slayer master access is region- and requirement-gated. No task lists invented here — only master location, access gates, and planner region mapping.
methods.policy: Do not invent assignment tables. Prefer/block and task composition stay on wiki Slayer master pages. Focus region unlock + combat/Slayer level gates.

masters.region_note: User assumes Forinthry/wilderness framing for Raptor. Building sits at Fort Forinthry; Catalyst historically taxed Fort under Misthalin. Dual-label until Equilibrium hard boundary.

masters.task_region_combo: Master access ≠ task kill location. Raptor can assign creatures that live outside Fort/Misthalin — plan travel/region pairs per assignment, not only master region.

methods.summary: Master access region + task kill region + supply region often diverge. These are the combos that matter for Equilibrium region picks.

combos.issue: Raptor lives at Fort Forinthry, but his assignments are not Fort-local only. Picking a region for Raptor access does not unlock every creature he assigns.
combos.planner_action: Score Raptor as a master hub unlock; score task monsters separately by kill location.

combos.issue: Mandrith is the clean Forinthry-locked master: access + completion both require Wilderness. Prefer/block ignored — bad task = skip/death risk, not re-roll via list.
combos.planner_action: Only plan Mandrith when Forinthry is unlocked and Wilderness risk is acceptable.

combos.issue: Morvran access is hard Tirannwn (Plague's End), but many high-value tasks live in other regions (e.g. abyssal creatures Forinthry/Desert pyramid routes, Lost Grove Tirannwn-local, etc.).
combos.planner_action: Tirannwn for master hub; do not assume all Morvran XP is Tirannwn-sourced.

combos.issue: Laniakea is Anachronia-gated; dinosaurs are Anachronia-local, but her list still includes non-Anachronia creatures (exact list not duplicated here).
combos.planner_action: Anachronia buys master access + dino tasks; keep off-island task destinations as separate region edges.

combos.issue: Ancient Cavern access is Kandarin/Barbarian Training; tasks still scatter worldwide.
combos.planner_action: Kuradal is a Kandarin hub tax, not a Kandarin-only kill plan.

combos.issue: Sumona requires Smoking Kills (Desert). Points doubling from that quest benefits every standard master globally — Desert quest value leaks outside Desert.
combos.planner_action: Count Smoking Kills as global Slayer economy unlock with Desert access cost.

combos.issue: Best Fletching XP room is Fort-local, but post-rebalance materials pull Desert/Anachronia/Smithing regions.
combos.planner_action: Workroom is a hub bonus, not a closed supply loop.

combos.issue: AoE Ranged training wants chins; highest tier black chins now tax Havenhythe, not Wilderness. User Forinthry assumption is stale.
combos.planner_action: Gate black-chin supply on Havenhythe; grey/red on Kandarin Hunter areas. Mechanised path adds Invention on red chins.

combos.optional_hub: Ranger's Workroom for dinarrow construct saves
combos.issue: Zygomite Carestyling XP is Anachronia-only; finishing dinarrows efficiently may want Fort workroom T2+ — cross-region skilling commute.
combos.planner_action: Anachronia for components/XP; Misthalin/Forinthry Fort for construct bonuses if both unlocked.

combos.master_can_be: any high master that assigns them
combos.issue: Classic master-in-A / monsters-in-B pattern already documented in planner-expansions-slayer scrapes.
combos.planner_action: Keep multi-route monsters as region_options arrays; never collapse to master region alone.
